messages.run: data {seconds (10), period_ms (500), n (400000, at most), kind loop|mix}: timer.every callbacks of n loop turns each, for seconds of time.mono(). Replies {running}.
messages.result: The last run: {kind, n, calls, turns, busy_ms (time inside the loops), elapsed_ms, worst_ms, worst_gap_ms, done}.
messages.fill: data {lines (50), widgets (60)}: print lines of 100 characters and make labels, so that a status is a few KB. Replies {lines, widgets}.
messages.spin: Run without end: the call budget stops it and the app crashes with the budget's reason (a check of the budget).
